ms_per_token_scope: slope across single-window points only, 16 to 94 tokens. Do not apply it across the window boundary.
note: Measured on the Gather-only INT8 re-export, which is the artifact the library loads. It replaces a sweep taken on the withdrawn published export, which was about three times cheaper and lost an entity on 13 of 120 texts. Cost is linear in tokens within a window and steps at each window boundary, so a single slope describes the range up to 94 tokens and nothing above it.

window_step.note: a window holds 94 content tokens, so text longer than that is a second forward pass. The step is most of a pass, not a per-token increment: it costs about as much as 21 tokens would inside a window.
